audit_scope.operating_system_closure: OS DLLs/API sets are supplied by Windows, not copied or recursively bundled
audit_scope.normal_imports: all packaged roots and recursive app-local CRT dependencies
audit_scope.delay_imports: PE directory parsed, all discovered imports classified
audit_scope.source_audit: reviewed separately; source hashes pinned below

requirements.elevation: All three EXE embedded manifests are inspected below. Optional diagnostics capabilities may be partial; no install or elevation performed.
requirements.external_steam_requirements: Valve ended Steam support for 32-bit Windows on 2026-01-01. Existing legacy clients may function temporarily, but this package does not promise a supported complete workflow on Windows x86. Legitimate installed Steam/Half-Life and official runtime remain required.
requirements.os_reason: Launcher hard-imports SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext; function-specific Microsoft minimum is 1703. PE header 6.0 is not the effective API minimum.
requirements.cpu: x86 with SSE2 is the MSVC default baseline; retained selected Release command logs contain no global AVX/AVX2 flag. Optional SDL/runtime SIMD paths may dispatch by CPU capability. No exhaustive binary instruction reachability audit or old-CPU execution was performed.
requirements.os: Windows 10 x64 with WOW64, version 1703 (build 15063) or later by launcher API contract. Packaged modules remain x86. Windows 10 32-bit is not promised for the complete Steam-dependent workflow.
requirements.opengl: Hardware driver providing OpenGL 3.3 Core; SDL requests major=3 minor=3 core and renderer validates it. No bundled software renderer/opengl32.
requirements.vc_runtime: Required x86 VC143 Release files included app-local from configured same-major.minor official REDIST; Windows 10 supplies UCRT. No installer required for these files on intact supported Windows 10.

runtime_loading_audit.detail: LoadLibraryExW with DLL_LOAD_DIR and SYSTEM32 search after provenance/architecture validation; function exports checked; stock auth never stubbed
Normal path gets GL procedures via SDL; GLAD includes optional built-in opengl32 fallback loader; no external shader files required

XInput fallback, WASAPI avrt, hid, combase, DPI/dark-mode functions, optional Vulkan/D3D/camera backends; game selects OpenGL, not Vulkan/D3D renderer. SDL_DYNAMIC_API environmental override is upstream capability; package supplies no override DLL
Resolved from GetModuleFileNameW, not current directory or PATH; optional developer-only PowerShell zip helper is guarded by file existence and not required for game
WPR/ADK and hardware counters not required to launch game; no third-party sensor DLL or tool installed
